title: MMC_BUILTIN:twolayerslab
description: Mesh-based Monte Carlo (MMC) demo: a 60x60x30 mm two-layer slab discretized into a regular tetrahedral mesh (15376 nodes, 81000 tets; 10 mm top layer mua=0.02/mm over a low-absorption bottom layer), illuminated by a pencil beam at the top surface center. Runs the dual-grid DMMC ray tracer (RayTracer: g) on the GPU, producing a voxel fluence volume. Use the Preview cross-section sliders to slice the mesh and inspect the layers.
